title: Rust tunnel_auth check_time rollback wipes replay/revocation floors; Python retains them (P-R divergence)
description: Found by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-0rep (two reviewers converged, P1). rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:419-425 check_time() calls self.clear() on clock rollback, wiping entries AND replay_floors and resetting last_now=None (clear():213-218). Python mirror python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py:405-414 _observe_time() clears ONLY _entries and explicitly retains floors/_revoked/_last_now with comment: 'Retain replay/revocation floors and the high-water time so a captured grant cannot rearm merely because the clock moved back'. Attack: attacker with a captured valid root-signed POST + ability to roll the gateway clock back replays it after rollback; Rust has no floors (wiped) and last_now=None so the backdated now passes check_time and expiry (claim.expiry<=backdated now), the post is re-accepted and re-arms the data plane; Python denies. Cross-impl divergence: same inputs, Rust accepts, Python denies. Also untested for floor retention (rollback test at :1009-1016 asserts denial only). Fix: mirror Python - clear() only entries on rollback (keep floors and last_now high-water), and pin with a unit test asserting floor retention post-rollback. Note: pinning test direction_scope_clock_and_capacity_fail_closed (:1009-1016) asserts UnauthorizedTunnel AFTER rollback because entries were wiped; with floors retained, authorize_decapsulation still denies (no entry) but the assertion reason may change - update per new semantics, do not weaken.
close_reason: Fixed: tunnel_auth check_time on clock rollback now wipes ONLY entries (self.entries.fill(None)) and returns ClockRollback, retaining replay_floors, _revoked flags, last_now high-water, and clock - mirroring python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py _observe_time:405-414 exactly. Previously self.clear() also wiped replay_floors and reset last_now=None, so a captured root-signed POST replayed after a clock rollback was re-accepted and re-armed the data plane (Rust accepted what Python denies). Pinned by new test rollback_retains_replay_floors_high_water_and_denies_rearm: rollback denial at now=5, retained high-water (now=4 still ClockRollback), captured-post replay at now=52 denied with TunnelAuthError::Replay via the retained floor (old code: Ok re-arm), fresh higher-path_seq grant accepted at 53 (floor advancement, genuine re-arm requires a fresh root signature). Also fixed in the same diff per review: 4w24 (last_now advances on every non-rollback observation) and the existing rollback test's UnauthorizedTunnel assertion remains valid (entry lookup fails; floors not consulted there). Verification on heft: gateway lib 221/221, clippy -D-level clean, fmt applied. 3x delegated codereview: correctness PASS (clear() has no other callers; Replay reachable at now=52 via retained floor; fresh-grant leg exercises genuine floor advancement), security found 4w24 (P1, fixed - watermark lag voided the rollback defense on quiet gateways; set_root full wipe confirmed intact; retained watermark self-heals, no lockout), edge PASS (now==last_now boundary consistent with floor >= convention; expiry-after-watermark-advance correct; post-rollback re-arm requires fresh root signature). Residual P1 family member aqyw (silent LRU floor eviction) remains open for a future round.
